messages.subject: facet_grid and scales
parts:
hi,

I print different time series values using facet_grid with
scales = "free".

If I print only a small range of the timeseries data (using
scale_x_date), the scale of the y axis is still adjusted to the whole
data range.

Is there any possibility besides fixed scales and free scales?

A simple example (but in my case a and b do not have the same scale):

df = data.frame(year=rep(c(1990:2099), each=2), value=c(rnorm(40),
rnorm(180, 15, 5)), levels=rep(factor(c("a","b")), 110))

qplot(x=year, y=value, data=df, geom="line") + facet_grid(levels~.,
scale="free_y") + scale_x_date("", limits=c(1990,2009))


regards,

Stefan

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: facet_grid and scales
parts:
Hi Stefan,

Instead of using limits, you can use subset:

qplot(x=year, y=value, data=subset(df, year <= 2009), geom="line") +
